title: Cuban presidents of his boyhood
summary: He names the presidents Gomez, Zayas and Menocal and explains why independence generals became presidents.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Growing up under segregation: schools, neighborhoods, Jim Crow

blocks.x: Okay. All right, politically, What do you remember about that time period when you were about ten years old?
Well, at that time I think that Jose Miguel Gomez was the president and then after that was Zayas and then after that was Menocal.
Okay - Jose Miguel Gomez, What do you remember about him at all?

Well, he was a general in the - in the army. He was one of the helped to liberate Cuba from Spain and naturally all those generals they was the first to become president in Cuba because they had record, good record. They was heroes so .....
